asus-rog-falcata: Flexible split layout for gaming, though several find the link cable too short.
glorious-gmmk-3-pro: Heavy, tank-like build, but several hit loose or dead switch sockets.
lemokey-p1-he: Nice typing sound and intuitive software for gaming; one found the keycaps wore quickly.
razer-blackwidow-v4-75: Hot-swappable and sounds decent out of the box; a few report keys that double-strike or fail to register.
wooting-80he: Fast rapid trigger and a smooth, fairly quiet feel; a few had sticky or rattly stabilized keys.
